characters.name: 面馆老板
characters.design: Middle-aged male noodle shop owner, wearing a plain white cotton short-sleeve work shirt with rolled-up sleeves, dark canvas apron with light flour stains, short neat black hair, warm weathered face, focused gentle expression, natural morning light illuminating his face. Front waist-up view, authentic documentary style, textured skin and fabric details.

characters.name: 首位客人
characters.design: Young female guest sitting by the window, wearing a soft beige knit cardigan and light blue jeans, holding a reusable coffee cup, relaxed morning expression, soft natural light on her face, casual cozy vibe. Front upper-body view, warm lifestyle documentary style.

props.name: 揉面面团
props.design: Pale off-white wheat dough on a well-used wooden kneading board, slightly flour-dusted surface, soft pliable texture with subtle kneading marks, warm morning side light highlighting its soft uneven surface. Close-up view, food-focused cinematic style.

props.name: 煮面汤锅
props.design: Stainless steel pot of rolling boiling clear broth on a gas stove, thick wispy steam billowing out, small oil droplets and noodle fragments visible on the pot rim, warm stove glow illuminating the steam. Medium shot view, textured authentic kitchen style.

props.name: 第一碗热面
props.design: Steaming bowl of topped wheat noodles in plain white ceramic bowl, garnished with chopped green onion and a dash of chili oil, thick steam rising from the surface, placed on a simple wooden windowsill. Close-up view, warm food-focused cinematic style.

scenes.name: 面馆后厨操作区
scenes.design: Compact authentic noodle shop kitchen, floured wooden countertop, stainless steel stove, hanging copper cookware, soft diffused morning side light filtering through a frosted kitchen window, subtle warm stove glow, textured worn surfaces, vertical frame, cozy documentary atmosphere.

scenes.name: 窗边餐台
scenes.design: Simple wooden windowsill counter next to a large glass window overlooking the quiet morning street, soft natural morning light, a steaming bowl of noodles placed on it, warm low-contrast color grade, cozy authentic lifestyle vibe, vertical frame.
